changes: p1: broke the run-together string into honorific + personal name + caste title. Name is now Vīrasiṃha (best guess), and 'mubhājyū' and 'mahato' moved to titles. Confidence stays low.
Notes expanded: alternative segmentations and no date or place.

notes: The scribe's name is written as one run-together, corrupt string, 'mubhājyūvirasinumāhātuḥ', right after 'liṣitaṃ' (= likhitaṃ). Suggested split: 'mubhājyū' (perhaps mu[khya]/mū + Newari/Nepali honorific bhāju/bhājyū) + 'virasinu' (Vīrasiṃ/Vīrasiṃha, i.e. Bir Singh; the final -nu is unclear and may be part of the name, e.g. 'Vīrasinu', or a case ending) + 'māhātuḥ' (caste or office title Mahato/Mahat(o), Sanskritised with a visarga). Other splits are possible. The name stem is a guess. The rest of the colophon is the usual scribal formula ('śuddhaṃ vā aśuddhaṃ vā mama doṣo na dīyate'). It has no date, place or purpose.
